HCF and LCM Product, Class 10 board exam: HCF(306, 657) = 9, so find LCM(306, 657) in one step.

• HCF × LCM = product of the two numbers
• LCM = (306 × 657) / 9
• Divide first: 306 / 9 = 34
• LCM = 34 × 657 = 22338
